title: Bind Management Shadow to the existing Agora decision-lock owner

hosted_incident_evidence.root_cause: In default BFF composition (compose_bff_app -> mount_bff_routers), create_agora_router initialized the authoritative AgoraWriteService decision-lock owner via _default_decision_lock_owner() only for create_trading_room_router, whereas mount_bff_routers bound create_attribution_router's lock_reader exclusively to dependencies.get('agora_owner') (which is None in normal BFF startup). As a result, Management Shadow treated the configured Agora decision-lock owner as unconfigured/unavailable (HTTP 200 degraded agora_owner_unavailable) for the same decision key where Trading Room returned HTTP 404 decision_lock_not_found.

changes.summary: Resolved decision_lock_owner once in create_agora_router (using _UNSET_DECISION_LOCK_OWNER so an explicit None is never replaced by a default substitute), passed the single resolved owner to create_trading_room_router, and exposed router.decision_lock_owner on the returned Agora router.

Forwarded any explicit decision_lock_owner/agora_owner dependency into create_agora_router and bound Management Attribution's _read_agora_lock (and platform_source_router fallback) to the shared agora_router.decision_lock_owner accessor/instance so native Trading Room and Management Shadow share the exact same Agora decision-lock owner without duplicate writable owners or default substitutes.

Added test_composed_bff_shares_single_agora_decision_lock_owner_between_trading_room_and_shadow exercising compose_bff_app() to prove a single AgoraWriteService owner instance serves both native Trading Room and Management Shadow, unknown locks with no attribution return 404 on both routes, real store refusal/unconfigured owner stays distinguishable as degraded agora_owner_unavailable, and same-tenant trader/operator and cross-tenant negative visibility rules hold on both routes.

Recorded the BFF bac80d756dec67b19c9af5183eae7a9869835015 hosted read differential under RC6 WP6.3 and RC2 linked to BFF-ATTRIBUTION-SHADOW-OWNER-WIRING-20261122 while retaining hosted lock, settlement, linked MT-4, attribution and Management crawl acceptance with AGORA-SHADOW-ATTRIBUTION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261116 and MGMT-GATE-FULL-PASS-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261114.

acceptance_criteria_verification.ac1_shared_owner_instance_and_404_vs_una: Verified through compose_bff_app() in test_composed_bff_shares_single_agora_decision_lock_owner_between_trading_room_and_shadow: build_agora_write_service is called once, get_active_trading_room_service().decision_lock_owner is app.state.agora_router.decision_lock_owner, a permitted known lock is readable on both /bff/agora/trading-room/decision-events/{id}/decision-lock and /bff/management/attribution/shadow/{id}, an unknown decision with no attribution resolves to HTTP 404 on both routes, store refusal degrades with agora_owner_unavailable while keeping settlement data, and unconfigured DSN leaves decision_lock_owner as None without a substitute.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac2_tenant_and_actor_visibility_preserve: Verified in test_composed_bff_shares_single_agora_decision_lock_owner_between_trading_room_and_shadow and existing test_attribution_views.py / test_agora_shadow_mode.py tests: same-tenant trader reads only their own lock (without operator-only trader_identity block on shadow), same-tenant operator reads full lock and trader_identity/account_id + four arms with independent attribution/agora source statuses, and same-tenant other trader plus cross-tenant trader/operator receive HTTP 404 on both routes.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac3_validation_and_register_record: Ran BFF composition, Trading Room, shadow mode, and attribution test suites; recorded the exact hosted read differential in docs/operations/problem-register.md while keeping genuine hosted lock, settlement, and Management browser acceptance in AGORA-SHADOW-ATTRIBUTION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261116 and MGMT-GATE-FULL-PASS-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261114.

runtime_budget.note: Reuses the existing AgoraWriteService decision-lock owner instance already created by create_agora_router; adds no new writer, table, route, or credential.
